name: Arikara
summary: From Thunder Bluff, Magatha Grimtotem warns that Arikara may be hunting High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof. She sends Horde adventurers to summon and slay the ancient wind serpent at the burial spires of Thousand Needles.

sections.title: A Beast in the Smoke
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem enchants refined Incendia powder to call Arikara. She warns that ancient tauren traditions have changed too quickly under the new Horde alliance. Those changes, she says, stirred the vengeance of the ferocious wind serpent spirit. So she sends you south to the canyon of Thousand Needles. There, among the elevated burial sites of Darkcloud Pinnacle, you are to cast the powder onto a ritual pyre.

sections.title: Doubt at Whitereach Post
sections.body: After you slay Arikara on the burial needle and claim its skin, you bring the remains to Motega Firemane at Whitereach Post. Motega is bewildered. He finds it hard to believe that a primal spirit would bear malice toward Cairne Bloodhoof. Yet he sets his doubts aside rather than openly question Magatha, the tribe's most powerful shaman, and rewards you for protecting the chieftain.

faq.answer: Arikara is a powerful wind serpent summoned atop Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles. Magatha says changes from traditional tauren lore stirred the beast to vengeance.

faq.q: Why does Magatha Grimtotem want Arikara dead?
faq.answer: Magatha says Arikara is hunting Cairne Bloodhoof, the High Chieftain of the tauren. She sends you to destroy the serpent with enchanted Incendia powder before it can threaten Thunder Bluff's leader.

faq.q: Where is the sacred fire located to summon her?
faq.answer: The unlit sacred fire of life stands atop an isolated spire within Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles, where local tauren bury their dead.

faq.q: Why is Motega Firemane skeptical of the hunt?
faq.answer: Magatha fears Arikara may be stalking Cairne and asks you to bring proof of the hunt to Motega. When you deliver the remains, Motega's doubts become clear.

faq.q: Is Cairne actually in danger from Arikara?
faq.answer: Magatha says she fears Arikara may be stalking Cairne. Her warning calls for action, but does not establish the danger independently.

faq.q: What is the previous quest in this chain?
faq.answer: This story follows "Sacred Fire." There, adventurers gather Incendia Agave from the Boiling Pool in Thousand Needles for Magatha Grimtotem to enchant into Incendia powder.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see the tension between ancestral rites and political shifts under Cairne Bloodhoof's leadership. The Grimtotem are caught in the matter.
As a shaman, you can see the friction between elemental ritual and political intrigue. Motega is reluctant to challenge Magatha's spiritual authority.
As a member of the Horde, you march into Thousand Needles to counter any threat to Cairne Bloodhoof, the venerable High Chieftain you are sworn to protect.
